items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: I told him, I said, Red, I said, this your band. I said, it's not my band. He wouldn't go.

ctx.x: You told me once when he wouldn't walk, he sat down. Yeah, he sat down.

I told him, I said, Red, I said, this your band. I said, it's not my band. He wouldn't go. And Remus, that's the time Remus got angry. You know? Remus said, I'm going to stop fooling these fellas. He said, man, these fellas, they got their band and they hired a player with them and then they don't want to work. You know what I mean? I said, you were right about that. So, well, when I get jobs like that, they always want me to work. You know what I mean? But I wasn't particularly, you know what I mean? I just get…
